mapper.update: UPDATE TB_HR_DEV SET use_yn='N', mod_user_id='SYSTEM', mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE use_yn='Y' AND retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND retire_dt < #{day}
UPDATE TB_PJ_PROJ SET proj_stat_cd='END', mod_user_id='SYSTEM', mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE proj_stat_cd='ING' AND ctrt_end_dt < #{day}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' ORDER BY u.user_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.reg_dttm < #{cutoff} AND upper(h.trgt_tbl_nm) NOT LIKE 'TB\_PJ\_%' AND upper(h.trgt_tbl_nm) NOT LIKE 'TB\_CO\_%' AND upper(h.trgt_tbl_nm) NOT IN ('TB_HR_DEV_PRC','TB_HR_MON_PAY') AND NOT (upper(h.trgt_tbl_nm)='TB_HR_DEV' AND h.chg_item_nm IN ('월 단가','월 급여·지급액'))
